title: Queue-inversion tableau formula for all modified Macdonald polynomials with formal q and t
author: Ayyer, Arvind; Mandelshtam, Olya; Martin, James B
work: Modified Macdonald polynomials and the multispecies zero-range process: I
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs new queue-inversion signed involutions and degenerate-filling bijections, proves symmetry through LLT ribbon expansions, and establishes both Macdonald triangularity conditions by exhaustive weighted-word transformations. Full telescoping identities and all special word cases are supplied, so the final uniqueness argument does not assume the claimed tableau formula.
